git add internal/mission/aborted_writer_drift_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(mission): drift-guard on DelegationVerdictAborted's three write sites (K4)

Review finding K4 (full-branch review, m-2026-09-08-004 round 3), HIGH:
countBlockingDelegations's unconditional aborted-verdict exclusion is
safe only because DelegationVerdictAborted is written by exactly three
call sites, all firing before a worker process starts -- but nothing in
the type system enforced that count. CloseDelegationSkeleton is
exported and takes any verdict string; a fourth pre-Close writer (a
"cancel a running worker" command is the obvious future candidate)
would silently let a delegation whose worker did real work stop
blocking Abandon, with no event, no attestation, no error.

Adds an AST-based drift guard, modeled on internal/mcpclass's own
source-parsing discipline (TestIdentityMethodsMatchGate): parses
store.go, pretooluse_dispatch.go, and subagent_start.go, finds every
WRITE-position occurrence of DelegationVerdictAborted (an assignment
RHS or a call argument -- explicitly excluding the const declaration,
switch-case validation labels, and the read-side == comparison), and
fails if the set of enclosing functions differs from the known three
(closeDelegationAborted, Close, closeSkeletonOnHashRefusal).

Falsified by temporarily inserting a fourth CloseDelegationSkeleton
call site into store.go and confirming the test catches it (reverted
before committing) -- this is a guard test, not a bugfix, so there is
no pre-existing behavior to git-stash-falsify against; the insert-and-
revert probe is the equivalent proof that the guard actually guards.
EOF
)"
